selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out look-alikes like chamomile or aster based on petal/disc ratio.
To check for subtle AI artifacts such as melting petal edges, inconsistent lighting, or texture smearing in the high-frequency details of the petals.
To ensure the boundary between the yellow disc and white petals is sharp and physically plausible, checking for color bleeding or fusion.

focus_areas: Texture consistency of the yellow central disc (granular vs. smooth)
Edge sharpness and individual separation of white ray petals
Lighting coherence between the flower and the blurred background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the yellow center and white petals. AI generators often blur this boundary or create unnatural halos. Also, verify if the petal count and spacing follow a natural Fibonacci-like spiral or if they appear randomly placed/overlapping unnaturally.
